precedence: Later explicit owner corrections override older schematic labels; measurements are not inferred from nominal components.

ntc.note: Owner explicitly confirmed installed 3.3k; overrides older R32=4.7k drawing. Nominal conversion, not measured CO calibration.

damper.reference: Operator physically identifies EXHAUST; Hall alone cannot identify endpoint at boot
damper.note: 4000ms derives from 1600 pulses / (30 driver RPM * 800 pulses/revolution / 60); not measured damper speed.

analog_circuit.note: Nominal schematic values only; cannot infer sensor-specific zero/span or installed tolerance.

fan.note: Owner confirmed PA8 controls fan. Phase delay and airflow table still require measurement.

communications.protocol: Board master Modbus RTU 19200 8E1; PLC=1, lux=2, debug=247
communications.note: Later disconnected status overrides planned hardware; protocol is the board contract, not proof of deployed slave firmware.

external_supervisor.cutoff_evidence: Current-chat owner answer: external circuit can remove valve-coil power while Q7 remains ON. This is a reported hardware capability, not measured feedback to STM32.
external_supervisor.note: Known absence of feedback connection is an integration gap, not an unknown GPIO value.

timing.note: Owner settings and authorized software defaults; not measurements or independent approval of the burner.

software.adc: HmiMonitorIo configures six-channel 20Hz DMA, overriding initial adc.c setup
software.mixer_ntc: Optional; not used for sample cooling or combustion routing

measurements_required: CO zero/span/polarity across reference concentrations and temperature; verify usable analog range and clipping.
Fan start/run command versus actual airflow/RPM, airflow proof time, PA9 phase offset and PA8 gate behavior.
Sample fill/transfer/CO response, cooling below 40 C, flame and CO settling after air adjustment.
Damper arrival/Hall repeatability, stall handling and actual unpowered behavior.
Shutdown response of actual valve/ignition and independent interlock path during fault/reset/power interruption.
integration_gaps: No STM32 acquisition path for external safety/airflow/fuel-off/ignition-off/fan-stop proofs.
RS485 transceiver disconnected; AUTO daylight source unavailable until connected.
design_decisions: CO acceptance/adjust/trip limits and admissible uncertainty.
Equipment-specific purge requirement and fault ventilation policy.
Initial air and bounded adjustment policy after measured fan/combustion response.
optional: Mixer NTC conversion is not required for TC2-controlled sample cooling.
PLC/RS485 is not required for local MANUAL operation; real daylight is required for AUTO.
